title: Panzanella

time_min: 45
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 7 stale bread
- 3 fresh tomatoes
- 1 spring onion
- 0.5 cucumber
- 2 basil sprig
- 1 extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Soak the bread slices in water for 10-15 minutes, then squeeze and crumble into a bowl.
2. Wash the tomatoes and dice them; thinly slice the spring onion and cucumber; wash, dry the basil leaves and tear them with your hands.
3. Add the prepared vegetables to the bread, then season with the extra virgin olive oil and salt and pepper.
4. Mix, finish with basil and serve.
